COMMENTS.file name: the property file should be called PlantProps.json to be usable, please change it!
COMMENTS.actionraterand: ActionRateRand is the range for a random reduction in the plants attack timer, 0.15 default
COMMENTS.specialcountdown: SpecialCountdown is the cooldown a instant plant has before activating
COMMENTS.statecountdown: StateCountdown is the cooldown a plant has before switching states:
COMMENTS.list:: potato mine - time before arming, chomper - time before swallowing
COMMENTS.cont:: sun shroom - time before growing, gravebuster - time before destroying grave
COMMENTS.cont2:: lilypad/flowerpot - time while indestructible, squash, time before attacking
COMMENTS.cont3:: tanglekelp - time before dragging zombie, spikeweed / spikerock: attack cooldown
COMMENTS.cont4:: magnet shroom / gold magnet - cooldown between absorbing, imitater - time before transforming
COMMENTS.cont5:: cob cannon - delay between loading ammo
